/skill:godspeed
You are a Godspeed-enabled subagent.

1. **Name the axes.**
2. **Iterate cheap, in parallel.**
3. **Keep moves that improve any axis and harm none.**
4. **Don't aim — let the frontier walk itself.**

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.
# Assignment
# Target
Probe the C1 counter's named ceilings and the trial's blind spots with real sops behaviour.
# Change
1. Ceiling probe: write a trial in scratch that detects the counter's shims (e.g., `head -c2 $(command -v sops)` is '#!' under a shim) and answers BROKEN only then; run `bash /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/plans/round-48-c1.sh --tree <dir>` on a tree with it + /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-48/controls/fixtures/ref-entry-measured.md appended to the entry; record the value (the plan names this ceiling — confirm it numerically).
2. Blind spots: find one real sops 3.13.3 behaviour that contradicts or narrows an entry sentence the trial does not test (candidates: `rotate --add-age/--rm-age` combined; `updatekeys` on a file whose creation rule no longer matches; `decrypt` of a file whose MAC was edited; key-group fragments after removing a group). Execute in scratch with throwaway identities (env HOME=... per command, never print private keys) and report the observed output.
3. Save /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-48/build/K48CriticCeiling.md with commands, rc, output.
# Acceptance
Ceiling value recorded; at least two executed sops behaviours with exact outputs and how each bears on the entry.

# Assignment
# Target
Registry plumbing for the two new release-identity rows (S103 sops v3.13.3 release page, S104 age v1.3.2 release page) and a census-validated scratch mirror.
# Change
1. S=$HYAKU_SCRATCH/kagi-r48/K48ExecSources; mkdir -p "$S/tree"; trap 'rm -rf -- "$S"' EXIT; `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin archive 52991e5da64cbacaa724b28b407cf5765fd21b41 | tar -x -C "$S/tree"`.
2. Fetch https://github.com/getsops/sops/releases/tag/v3.13.3 and https://github.com/FiloSottile/age/releases/tag/v1.3.2 with `curl -sSL --compressed -A 'Mozilla/5.0'` (record date -u, http code, bytes, sha256). Pick for each a ≤25-word quote that pins the version (locate it with `python3 /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/corpus/rendered-text-v1.py locate <body> '<quote>'`, count ≥1).
3. In "$S/tree": append rows S103/S104 to corpus/SOURCES.md in the exact 11-column schema (model on S033; used-by `corpus/knowledge/sops-age-key-rotation.md`; status mined; tier A; recheck `90d`; no `|` in cells; confirm S103 is the next free id); add matching 16-column rows to corpus/source-fetches.tsv modelled exactly on the S099/S094 rows (read corpus/sources-census.sh SC_FETCH rules first; column 3 = sha256 of `printf 'S103\tmined\t<url>\n'`); store bodies at "$S/tree/.ufo/waves/round-48/capture/S103.body" / S104.body; add the ids to the entry's `source:` line (S009 … ; S103 (...); S104 (...)) so the citation handshake holds.
4. Validate: `(cd "$S/tree" && bash corpus/sources-census.sh; echo rc=$?)` and `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/scripts/sources-census.sh validate --file "$S/tree/corpus/SOURCES.md"; echo rc=$?` — both must be clean (warnings allowed for the fleet one).
5. Save to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-48/build/K48ExecSources/: rows.md (exact SOURCES lines), fetch-rows.tsv (exact source-fetches lines), source-line.txt (the entry's new `source:` line), S103.body, S104.body, receipts.txt.
